mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals severe labor market distress triggering risk-off flows that produce negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y), the Federal Reserve's likely policy tightening causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% (y/y), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) trend indicates strengthening labor market conditions that drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing slowdowns that generate negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 95.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST increase, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%), a declining unemployment rate signals labor market recovery that generates positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5% and declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
